Nothing in the app has changed

This one is housekeeping. No new features, no fixes — 0.1.2 behaves exactly like 0.1.1, and there is nothing here you need to go and look at.

Why it exists

Crisper is distributed directly rather than through the App Store, so the machinery that builds, signs and delivers these updates is ours to get right. Every release is now built from a recorded snapshot of its own source and tagged before it is built, rather than after — which means any version you are running can be traced back to exactly the code it came from. That guarantee is not worth much on its own; it is worth something when a later release needs to be checked, and it only works if it is in place beforehand.

This release is also the first end-to-end test of the updater itself — the quiet daily check, the background download, and the Install Update line waiting in the menu instead of a window in front of your work.
